description: XP curve v2 save migration: characters without xpCurve 2 have every stored XP value converted from the old linear curve, keeping level and the fraction of progress within the level; the original values stay in the character as hxpLegacy (rollback copy; no extra storage key, so hero-mode storage isolation holds). New characters start with xpCurve 2.

edits.name: Convert legacy XP in cleanHxp
Mark cleaned characters as curve v2 and keep legacy XP
edits.new: hxp: cleanHxp(h), xpCurve: 2, ...(h.xpCurve === 2 ? (h.hxpLegacy && typeof h.hxpLegacy === 'object' ? { hxpLegacy: h.hxpLegacy } : {}) : (h.hxp && typeof h.hxp === 'object' ? { hxpLegacy: Object.assign({}, h.hxp) } : {})),

edits.name: New characters use curve v2
edits.new: hxp: cleanHxp({ level: 1, hxp: {}, xpCurve: 2 }), xpCurve: 2,
